purpose: Teach: 何気ない/あかね/たぐい/一回り/こじんまり/さかん/にこにこ/ひとえに

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の何気ない一言が、俺、結構嬉しかったぞ
lines.en: Riku — what you said so casually back then, it actually made me really happy.
lines.style: Soft, surprised admission. Not quite meeting his eyes. Hesitant but genuine. The kind of honesty that costs something to say out loud.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、あかね色の夕焼けを撮ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were taking photos of that crimson sunset, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Observant, gentle. Not a question. Quiet conviction in the noticing. Eyes holding on the memory. Careful, like something fragile.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、たぐいまれな絵の才能あるよ
lines.en: You've got a rare gift for art, Riku. Really.
lines.style: Direct, sincere. No flattery edge. Warm and steady. The confidence of someone who knows what she's looking at and isn't afraid to say it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、一回り大きくなったな、桜
lines.style: Soft observation. A small smile underneath. Not quite looking away. The admission of noticing her changes, quietly, over time.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、こじんまりして、いい雰囲気だな
lines.en: Your place has such a nice, cozy feeling to it.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, voice relaxed. Not performing. The relief of being somewhere that feels like it matters. Slight warmth in the tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、運動部もさかんに参加してんな、桜
lines.en: You really throw yourself into the sports club, don't you.
lines.style: Observant, quiet approval. Not prying. The tone of someone noticing and respecting the effort without making a show of it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、にこにこ笑顔が癒しだぞ
lines.en: Your smile when you laugh — it's honestly healing to be around.
lines.style: Tender, direct. Soft attack. The kind of sincerity that takes a breath to say. Slight tremor of vulnerability underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の合格は、ひとえに努力の賜物だな、桜
lines.en: Your passing the exam was all because of how hard you worked, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Gentle but firm. Not letting her deflect. The steadiness of someone defending her against her own doubt.
